search_window.basis: Conservative overlap beginning at the latest independently read-back verified Food Line supplementary heartbeat; searched recently indexed October 27-28 reports and direct sources to account for publication/indexing delays.

coverage_notes: Supplementary recall watch only; primary nationwide production collection remains authoritative. No editorial approval, publication, social post, schedule change, or task disabling.

Exactly 12 targeted web search operations were executed across the four high-value audit miss classes: sole/last/full-service grocery closures or losses; storm/flood/fire/outage-related emergency distribution cancellations; abrupt pantry/food-bank closures or major service reductions; and new official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruptions with immediate access impact.

No newly verified qualifying U.S. access disruption was identified in the bounded observation window. This is a finding about observed evidence, not proof of nationwide absence; late-indexed local notices remain possible.
The previously handed-off October 27 Wymore, Nebraska last-grocery report and October 27 South Philadelphia Community Fridge Point Breeze pantry fire were found again and excluded as duplicates.

October 27 local coverage of the Lulu M. Ross Elementary school fire in Milford, Delaware reported a Food Bank of Delaware school meal pickup response, not a canceled emergency distribution; incident occurred October 25 and reporting was outside this interval, so excluded.

An October 28 report about Catholic Charities Diocese of Cleveland replacing holiday home-delivery meals with site meals and pantry distributions says total services are expected to be maintained or expanded, not a verified abrupt overall service reduction; excluded.

Some search results recycled October 2025 SNAP-funding warnings. An October 27, 2026 third-party guide correction disavowed its own earlier October 2026 shutdown claims; there was no new substantiated official SNAP/WIC issuance or benefits interruption.
Historical grocery and pantry fires from September 2026 and earlier, routine programs, donation coverage, and unrelated commerce closures were excluded.
All 12 searches returned usable result sets and direct follow-up reads succeeded. Search-index precision is limited but no materially failed search/source request was observed.

With the latest directly verified prior ledger ending 2026-10-27T22:47:45.664-07:00, the search covers through this observation. A further intervening heartbeat was not independently established; overlap is intentional.
